ov: Small, striped burrowing squirrels of North America, plus the Siberian chipmunk of Asia. They carry food home in their cheek pouches and store it for winter.

why.h: Many chipmunks stay in their burrows through winter, feeding on a larder of stored food.

rg: North America; the Siberian chipmunk in Asia.
df: Seeds, nuts, fruit and buds, plus fungi, insects, worms, eggs and small frogs.

cf.tip: Chipmunks are small, striped, ground-living squirrels.

fx: Its seed-storing habit helps spread seedlings and fungi through forests.
